Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Subject: Audio Recording of Earning Conference Call discussing Q4 H2 FY2026 Results.  
Pursuant to Regulation 30(6) read with Para A of Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations

Relations tab.
